SELECT d.id, d.run_id, d.target_kind, d.target_id, d.action, d.confidence, d.reason, d.precedents, d.status, d.merge_id, d.question, d.trace, d.calls, d.created_at, d.decided_at, u.nick_name AS decided_by_name, a.canonical_name AS "left", b.canonical_name AS "right" FROM agent_decisions d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = d.decided_by LEFT JOIN resolution_reviews rr ON rr.id = d.target_id LEFT JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id LEFT JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id

SELECT count(*) FROM entity_merges m JOIN entities s ON s.id = m.source_id JOIN entities t ON t.id = m.target_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.reverted_at IS NOT NULL AND ((s.type_id = #{ta} AND t.type_id = #{tb}) OR (s.type_id = #{tb} AND t.type_id = #{ta}))

SELECT status = 'merged' FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('merged', 'kept') AND ((left_id = #{a} AND right_id = #{b}) OR (left_id = #{b} AND right_id = #{a})) ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT rr.id, rr.left_id, rr.right_id, rr.score, rr.reason, rr.stage, rr.created_at FROM resolution_reviews rr WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND ORDER BY rr.created_at, rr.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT rr.id, rr.left_id, rr.right_id, rr.score, rr.reason, rr.stage, rr.created_at FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND rr.id <> #{headId} AND AND (rr.left_id = ANY(#{entityIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) OR rr.right_id = ANY(#{entityIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) OR lower(a.canonical_name) = ANY(#{names,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}) OR lower(b.canonical_name) = ANY(#{names,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler})) ORDER BY rr.created_at, rr.id LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.update: UPDATE agent_decisions SET status = #{status}, decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{userId} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('proposed', 'applied')

UPDATE agent_decisions SET status = CASE WHEN action = #{action} THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'overridden' END, decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{userId} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND target_kind = 'review' AND target_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 'proposed'

UPDATE agent_decisions d SET status = 'superseded', decided_at = now() FROM resolution_reviews me JOIN entities ma ON ma.id = me.left_id JOIN entities mb ON mb.id = me.right_id, resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE me.id = #{reviewId} AND me.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.status = 'proposed' AND d.target_kind = 'review' AND d.target_id = rr.id AND rr.id <> me.id AND (rr.left_id IN (me.left_id, me.right_id) OR rr.right_id IN (me.left_id, me.right_id) OR lower(a.canonical_name) IN (lower(ma.canonical_name), lower(mb.canonical_name)) OR lower(b.canonical_name) IN (lower(ma.canonical_name), lower(mb.canonical_name)))
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_decisions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'reverted' AND decided_at >= #{since}

SELECT filename, quote FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (fe.chunk_id) d.filename, COALESCE(NULLIF(fe.quote, ''), left(c.text, 240)) AS quote FROM facts f -- 谓词可以为空（0010），LEFT JOIN 才不丢那些事实 LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = f.id JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f.subject_id = #{entityId} OR f.object_id = #{entityId}) AND NOT (coalesce(r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as', false) AND lower(trim(coalesce(fe.quote, ''))) = lower(f.object_value->>'value')) ORDER BY fe.chunk_id, coalesce(r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as', false), f.confidence DESC ) q LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM audit_events WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND actor_id IS NOT NULL AND action IN ('review.merge', 'review.keep', 'merge.manual', 'merge.revert') AND ( LIKE #{like} OR LIKE #{like}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.canonical_name AS name, t.label AS type_label, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id)) AS facts, (e.merged_into IS NOT NULL) AS merged FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND lower(e.canonical_name) LIKE #{like} ORDER BY e.merged_into IS NOT NULL, facts DESC, e.canonical_name LIMIT #{limit}
